newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle steady, slow at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle steady, slow at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not nough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand moderate.

Sales confirmed on 400 slaughter steers and 400 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 17,200 head confirmed including 900 head or about five percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3 1175-1200 lbs 72.00.
Slaughter heifers - Few Select with end Choice 2-3
1000-1100 lbs 72.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1200-1250
